newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Bomb blast on Pakistani train kills five.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blast on Pakistani train kills five.

text.p: A bomb blast on a Pakistani express train southeast of Islamabad on Sunday evening killed five people and injured eight, a railway official said.

He said the bomb exploded in the toilet of a carriage when the Tezgam train, which was coming from the southern port city of Karachi to Rawalpindi, reached Sohawa, about 70 km (43 miles) from Islamabad. It was not immediately clear who was responsible for the attack.
